description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R} or {W}{W}{W}.
Cast a copy of Pack a Punch from exile by paying {1}{W}{R}, unpreparing Kirol.
When you cast that spell, Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Diamond Lion leaves your graveyard, Kirol triggers, becoming prepared.
Pack a Punch resolves, causing you to mill a card, put two +1/+1 counters onto its target, and give it trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kirol, History Buff // Pack a Punch
